# Quran Online Tarteel

> Online Quran academy (since 2010) teaching children under 18 and women in live one-to-one classes, taught only by female teachers. Families in the USA, UK, Canada, Australia, the UAE, the Philippines and Pakistan. Every new student starts with 2 free classes.

Key facts: female teachers only, each with 10+ years of experience; 500+ children taught; 1-to-1 live classes; parents can sit in; plans of 2 or 4 days a week, or weekends; 25–30 minute classes (Tafseer 45–60); fees from $40 a month; WhatsApp +92 334 5259952.
